overall_summary: Analysis of the performance data clearly indicates that extreme space and planetary scenarios—specifically speculative 'What If You Fell Into...' formats and extreme exoplanet descriptions (e.g., diamond planets, liquid ice, extreme darkness)—are driving the highest views-per-day and engagement metrics (likes/comments per view). In contrast, standard educational facts and psychological tricks published over 30 days ago show significantly lower velocity. We must capitalize on the proven high-velocity space 'What If' curiosity gap while introducing a completely fresh celestial phenomenon to avoid repetition.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) generate strong views (over 900-1000) and healthy engagement relative to older straightforward facts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical immersion formats focusing on newly discovered or extreme cosmic bodies.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles featuring rare planetary properties (e.g., 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year', A9Qa-RmuOr0; 'The Planet Darker Than Coal', v1rrcZLdp4U) capture rapid short-form attention.
winning_patterns.action: Continue pairing counter-intuitive spatial anomalies with high-impact visual descriptors in the opening 3 seconds.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos covering psychological hacks and brain memories (e.g., ef3ND4qiRHc, 5AN7LUgqarc, mGEgENcGcNE) published more than 30 days ago have flattened out with minimal views (<60) and zero engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Pause production on psychological trick micro-shorts unless paired with a high-drama narrative or fresh visual framing.

weak_patterns.evidence: Simple declarative statements about animals or basic facts without a 'What If' or extreme comparative hook (e.g., F1kXwuXuNgo, Jc04LVKNd2s) underperform significantly in velocity.
weak_patterns.action: Shift entirely away from plain declarative titles to question-led or immersion-led hooks.
